title: Tiny, cute sunflower
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='55' width='6' height='40' rx='3' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- stem highlight -->
  <rect x='48' y='55' width='2' height='40' rx='1' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- left leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='78' rx='14' ry='7' transform='rotate(-25 36 78)' fill='#43A047'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='77' rx='11' ry='4.5' transform='rotate(-25 36 77)' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- right leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='68' rx='13' ry='6.5' transform='rotate(20 64 68)' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='67' rx='10' ry='4' transform='rotate(20 64 67)' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  
  <!-- petals - back layer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='9' ry='16' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='9' ry='16' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='37' rx='16' ry='9' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='37' rx='16' ry='9' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='22' rx='15' ry='8' transform='rotate(45 30 22)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='22' rx='15' ry='8' transform='rotate(-45 70 22)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='15' ry='8' transform='rotate(-45 30 52)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='52' rx='15' ry='8' transform='rotate(45 70 52)' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  
  <!-- center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='15' fill='#8D6E63'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='13' fill='#A1887F'/>
  
  <!-- seed pattern -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='10' fill='#6D4C41'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='8' fill='#795548'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='5' fill='#8D6E63'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#A1887F'/>
  
  <!-- cute face on center -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='35' r='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='35' r='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <path d='M46 40 Q50 44 54 40' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
